title: How a Projector Works in 60 Seconds 📽️🪞 #shorts
description:
Inside many projectors is a chip covered in millions of microscopic mirrors, one for every pixel. Each mirror tilts to send light either out through the lens or into a dark trap, flipping thousands of times a second to make shades of brightness, while a spinning color wheel adds red, green and blue. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#projector #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: Many projectors have a chip covered in over *2 million* tiny mirrors, one for every pixel.

steps.label: Lamp
steps.text: A very bright *lamp* or LED shines its light straight onto that *chip*.

steps.label: Mirrors
steps.text: Each mirror *tilts* one way to send light to the lens, or the other way into a dark *trap*.

steps.label: Shades
steps.text: They flip *thousands* of times a second. The longer a mirror stays on, the *brighter* its pixel.

steps.label: Color
steps.text: A spinning *color wheel* flashes red, green and blue so fast your eyes *blend* them.

steps.label: Lens
steps.text: Finally, a *lens* blows that tiny image up across the whole *screen*.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Light, mirrors, *lens*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
